member.name: M:CharacterRely.Content.ModCharacter.CharacterLib.GetAnimationStateMachine``1(System.Int32,System.Action{CharacterRely.Animation.SpineAnimationStateMachine{``0}})
member.summary: 获取本玩家指定轨道的状态机；首次创建时执行 configure，之后保持独立状态与计时。 可分别用移动枚举和动作枚举获取轨道 0、1；同一轨道只能由一种状态机控制。 状态机的完成转换由基类自动更新，角色只需调用 ChangeState。
member.param: 独占控制的轨道编号，通常基础动作是 0，上半身动作是 1。

member.param: 首次创建时绑定骨骼或设置接管条件；释放重建后重新执行。

member.name: M:CharacterRely.Content.ModCharacter.CharacterLib.PlayAnimation(System.String,System.Boolean,System.Single,System.Boolean,System.Int32)
member.summary: 选择动作。重复调用同名、同循环模式的动作保持进度；restart: true 从头开始。
member.param: 模型中实际存在的动画名称。
是否循环播放，默认为 true。
从前一动作过渡到本动作的时长，单位为秒。
是否强制从头重播同一个动作。
轨道编号，默认 0；较高轨道只覆盖其动画有关键帧的属性。
member.returns: 当前轮的播放进度，范围 0～1；非循环播放结束后为 1。

member.name: M:CharacterRely.Content.ModCharacter.CharacterLib.SetHandRotation(System.String,System.Single)
member.summary: 手部骨骼的局部旋转偏移，单位为弧度。叠加于当前动画，0 恢复动画姿势。 boneName 是骨骼名，不是插槽名；整条手臂应传上臂骨骼名。 设置会保留，且重复设置不会累加；左右翻转由 Animator.FlipX 处理。
member.param: 手部或上臂的骨骼名，可从 Animator.BoneNames 获取。
相对动画姿势的弧度偏移；未镜像时正值为屏幕顺时针。

member.name: T:Spine.Timeline
member.summary: 全部动画时间轴共同实现的接口。 The interface for all timelines.

member.name: M:Spine.Timeline.Apply(Spine.Skeleton,System.Single,System.Single,Spine.ExposedList{Spine.Event},System.Single,Spine.MixBlend,Spine.MixDirection)
member.summary: 将时间轴应用到骨架。lastTime 为上次时间，time 为当前动画时间，单位为秒；事件触发区间为 (lastTime, time]。events 接收事件，null 忽略事件；alpha 为 0～1 的混合权重，blend 决定与初始或当前姿势混合的方式，direction 决定淡入或淡出。Applies this timeline to the skeleton.
member.param: 接受时间轴姿势的骨架，可访问骨骼、插槽和约束。 The skeleton the timeline is being applied to. This provides access to the bones, slots, and other skeleton components the timeline may change.

上次应用的动画时间（秒）；事件检测不包含此起点。 The time this timeline was last applied. Timelines such as trigger only at specific times rather than every frame. In that case, the timeline triggers everything between lastTime (exclusive) and time (inclusive).
当前动画时间（秒），用于定位相邻关键帧并插值。 The time within the animation. Most timelines find the key before and the key after this time so they can interpolate between the keys.
接收本次触发的事件；null 表示忽略事件。 If any events are fired, they are added to this list. Can be null to ignore firing events or if the timeline does not fire events.

混合权重 0～1；0 保留当前或初始姿势，1 完全应用时间轴值，中间值用于淡入淡出及分层。 0 applies the current or setup value (depending on blend). 1 applies the timeline value. Between 0 and 1 applies a value between the current or setup value and the timeline value. By adjusting alpha over time, an animation can be mixed in or out. alpha can also be useful to apply animations on top of each other (layered).
alpha 小于 1 时与初始或当前姿势混合的方式。 Controls how mixing is applied when alpha < 1.
淡入或淡出方向，影响附件和绘制顺序等瞬时切换时间轴。 Indicates whether the timeline is mixing in or out. Used by timelines which perform instant transitions, such as or .

member.name: P:Spine.Timeline.PropertyId
member.summary: 属性编号同时标识时间轴类型和它影响的骨架属性，用于检测动画间的属性重叠。Uniquely encodes both the type of this timeline and the skeleton property that it affects.

member.name: T:Spine.MixBlend
member.summary: 决定时间轴与初始姿势或当前姿势的混合方式。 Controls how a timeline is mixed with the setup or current pose.

seealso.cref: !:Timeline.Apply(Skeleton, float, float, ExposedList, float, MixBlend, MixDirection)

member.name: F:Spine.MixBlend.Setup
member.summary: 从初始姿势混合到时间轴值，不使用当前值；首个关键帧之前恢复初始值。 Transitions from the setup value to the timeline value (the current value is not used). Before the first key, the setup value is set.

summary.para: 从当前姿势混合到时间轴值；首帧之前向初始姿势混合。用于首先应用的动画，瞬时切换时间轴在首帧前使用初始值。

Transitions from the current value to the timeline value. Before the first key, transitions from the current value to the setup value. Timelines which perform instant transitions, such as or , use the setup value before the first key.
First is intended for the first animations applied, not for animations layered on top of those.
从当前姿势混合到时间轴值；首帧之前保留当前值。用于叠加在已有动画之上的动画层。
Transitions from the current value to the timeline value. No change is made before the first key (the current value is kept until the first key).
Replace is intended for animations layered on top of others, not for the first animations applied.
将时间轴值按权重加到当前姿势上；首帧之前保留当前值，用于叠加动画层。
Transitions from the current value to the current value plus the timeline value. No change is made before the first key (the current value is kept until the first key).
Add is intended for animations layered on top of others, not for the first animations applied.

member.name: T:Spine.MixDirection
member.summary: 表示淡入或淡出：淡入使权重趋向 1，淡出使权重趋向 0、回到初始或当前姿势。 Indicates whether a timeline's alpha is mixing out over time toward 0 (the setup or current pose value) or mixing in toward 1 (the timeline's value).

seealso.cref: !:Timeline.Apply(Skeleton, float, float, ExposedList, float, MixBlend, MixDirection)

member.name: F:Spine.MixDirection.In
member.summary: 淡入：时间轴权重逐渐增加。

member.name: F:Spine.MixDirection.Out
member.summary: 淡出：时间轴权重逐渐减少。

summary.para: 动画状态控制器：推进时间、排队播放、动作淡入淡出及多轨道叠加；详见 Spine 运行时指南的动画应用章节。
Applies animations over time, queues animations for later playback, mixes (crossfading) between animations, and applies multiple animations on top of each other (layering).
See Applying Animations in the Spine Runtimes Guide.

member.name: F:Spine.AnimationState.EmptyAnimation
member.summary: 没有时间轴的空动画，用于淡入淡出占位。

members.member:
前一个时间轴已写入此属性，因此从当前姿势向本时间轴姿势混合。 1) A previously applied timeline has set this property.
Result: Mix from the current pose to the timeline pose.

这是首次写入此属性，后续轨道项不写入它，因此从初始姿势向时间轴姿势混合。 1) This is the first timeline to set this property.
2) The next track entry applied after this one does not have a timeline to set this property.
Result: Mix from the setup pose to the timeline pose.

这是首次写入，下一轨道项写入相同属性、再下一项不写入；保持该属性，避免混合过程出现姿势下陷。 1) This is the first timeline to set this property.
2) The next track entry to be applied does have a timeline to set this property.
3) The next track entry after that one does not have a timeline to set this property.
Result: Mix from the setup pose to the timeline pose, but do not mix out. This avoids "dipping" when crossfading animations that key the same property. A subsequent timeline will set this property using a mix.

连续多个轨道项写入相同属性时，记录第一个不写入该属性的后续项，用它的混合进度淡出当前属性，避免突然跳变。 1) This is the first timeline to set this property.
2) The next track entry to be applied does have a timeline to set this property.
3) The next track entry after that one does have a timeline to set this property.
4) timelineHoldMix stores the first subsequent track entry that does not have a timeline to set this property.
Result: The same as HOLD except the mix percentage from the timelineHoldMix track entry is used. This handles when more than 2 track entries in a row have a timeline that sets the same property.
Eg, A -> B -> C -> D where A, B, and C have a timeline setting same property, but D does not. When A is applied, to avoid "dipping" A is not mixed out, however D (the first entry that doesn't set the property) mixing in is used to mix out A (which affects B and C). Without using D to mix out, A would be applied fully until mixing completes, then snap into place.

后续轨道项也为同一插槽设置附件时，不按淡出方向恢复初始附件，使后续变形可从当前姿势混合。 1) An attachment timeline in a subsequent track entry sets the attachment for the same slot as this attachment timeline.
Result: This attachment timeline will not use MixDirection.out, which would otherwise show the setup mode attachment (or none if not visible in setup mode). This allows deform timelines to be applied for the subsequent entry to mix from, rather than mixing from the setup pose.

member.summary: 替换指定轨道的当前动画并丢弃排队动作；loop 控制循环，非循环超时保持末帧。返回 TrackEntry 可进一步设置；Dispose 事件之后不能保留该对象引用。Sets the current animation for a track, discarding any queued animations. If the formerly current track entry was never applied to a skeleton, it is replaced (not mixed from).

summary.para: 设置没有时间轴的空动画并清空队列，用于平滑淡入淡出；淡出使前一动作逐渐回到低轨道或初始姿势。时长为 0 仍需一帧。淡入可先设空动画，再排入新动作并设置混合时长。
Sets an empty animation for a track, discarding any queued animations, and sets the track entry's . An empty animation has no timelines and serves as a placeholder for mixing in or out.

Mixing out is done by setting an empty animation with a mix duration using either , , or . Mixing to an empty animation causes the previous animation to be applied less and less over the mix duration. Properties keyed in the previous animation transition to the value from lower tracks or to the setup pose value if no lower tracks key the property. A mix duration of 0 still mixes out over one frame.

Mixing in is done by first setting an empty animation, then adding an animation using and on the returned track entry, set the . Mixing from an empty animation causes the new animation to be applied more and more over the mix duration. Properties keyed in the new animation transition from the value from lower tracks or from the setup pose value if no lower tracks key the property to the value keyed in the new animation.

When this track entry is queued, Delay is the time from the start of the previous animation to when this track entry will become the current track entry (ie when the previous track entry >= this track entry's Delay).
affects the delay.

member.name: P:Spine.TrackEntry.TrackTime
member.summary: 此项成为当前项之后经过的轨道时间（秒）；可改为非零从动作中途开始，循环逻辑不受影响。 Current time in seconds this track entry has been the current track entry. The track time determines . The track time can be set to start the animation at a time other than 0, without affecting looping.

summary.para: 从轨道移除此项的轨道时间（秒），默认无限；到时且无队列、无未完成混合时恢复初始姿势并清空，可用空动画实现平滑退出。

The track time in seconds when this animation will be removed from the track. Defaults to the highest possible float value, meaning the animation will be applied until a new animation is set or the track is cleared. If the track end time is reached, no other animations are queued for playback, and mixing from any previous animations is complete, then the properties keyed by the animation are set to the setup pose and the track is cleared.
It may be desired to use rather than have the animation abruptly cease being applied.
动画区间起点（秒），默认 0；修改后可同步设置 AnimationLast，防止起点之前的事件误触发。
Seconds when this animation starts, both initially and after looping. Defaults to 0.
When changing the AnimationStart time, it often makes sense to set to the same value to prevent timeline keys before the start time from triggering.

member.name: P:Spine.TrackEntry.AnimationEnd
member.summary: 动画区间终点（秒），默认动画总时长；非循环停在此处，循环回到 AnimationStart。 Seconds for the last frame of this animation. Non-looping animations won't play past this time. Looping animations will loop back to at this time. Defaults to the animation .

member.name: P:Spine.TrackEntry.AnimationLast
member.summary: 上次应用的动画时间（秒）；事件区间为 (AnimationLast, AnimationTime]，默认 -1 以包含首次应用的零时刻事件。 The time in seconds this animation was last applied. Some timelines use this for one-time triggers. Eg, when this animation is applied, event timelines will fire all events between the AnimationLast time (exclusive) and AnimationTime (inclusive). Defaults to -1 to ensure triggers on frame 0 happen the first time this animation is applied.

member.name: P:Spine.TrackEntry.AnimationTime
member.summary: 根据 TrackTime 计算区间内的动画时间；TrackTime 为 0 时等于 AnimationStart。 Uses to compute the AnimationTime, which is between and . When the TrackTime is 0, the AnimationTime is equal to the AnimationStart time.

summary.para: 此轨道项的时间倍率，默认 1；MixTime 不受它影响，排队动作自动计算的延迟也可能需要相应调整。
Multiplier for the delta time when this track entry is updated, causing time for this animation to pass slower or faster. Defaults to 1.
is not affected by track entry time scale, so may need to be adjusted to match the animation speed.
When using with a Delay <= 0, note the { is set using the mix duration from the , assuming time scale to be 1. If the time scale is not 1, the delay may need to be adjusted.
See AnimationState for affecting all animations.
此轨道的混合权重；通常轨道 0 建立基础姿势，高轨道用 alpha 控制叠加强度。
Values < 1 mix this animation with the skeleton's current pose (usually the pose resulting from lower tracks). Defaults to 1, which overwrites the skeleton's current pose with this animation.
Typically track 0 is used to completely pose the skeleton, then alpha is used on higher tracks. It doesn't make sense to use alpha on track 0 if the skeleton pose is from the last frame render.

member.name: P:Spine.TrackEntry.MixingTo
member.summary: 正在淡入的后一轨道项，无混合时为 null；通过 MixingTo 构成混合链。 The track entry for the next animation when mixing from this animation to the next animation, or null if no mixing is currently occuring. When mixing to multiple animations, MixingTo makes up a linked list.

summary.para: 混合过程中保持前一动作全权重，可避免高轨道同属性混合时短暂下陷；新动作没有覆盖前一动作所有属性时可能产生跳变。
If true, when mixing from the previous animation to this animation, the previous animation is applied as normal instead of being mixed out.

When mixing between animations that key the same property, if a lower track also keys that property then the value will briefly dip toward the lower track value during the mix. This happens because the first animation mixes from 100% to 0% while the second animation mixes from 0% to 100%. Setting HoldPrevious to true applies the first animation at 100% during the mix so the lower track value is overwritten. Such dipping does not occur on the lowest track which keys the property, only when a higher track also keys the property.
Snapping will occur if HoldPrevious is true and this animation does not key all the same properties as the previous animation.
重置旋转方向缓存，使下次混合重新选择最短路径；通常首次应用选择方向后会持续保持，避免两角度变化时来回翻转。
Resets the rotation directions for mixing this entry's rotate timelines. This can be useful to avoid bones rotating the long way around when using and starting animations on other tracks.

Mixing with involves finding a rotation between two others, which has two possible solutions: the short way or the long way around. The two rotations likely change over time, so which direction is the short or long way also changes. If the short way was always chosen, bones would flip to the other side when that direction became the long way. TrackEntry chooses the short way the first time it is applied and remembers that direction.

把局部顶点转换为世界坐标，并应用插槽变形。start、count 按浮点值计数，每顶点两个值；offset 指定输出起点，stride 指定相邻坐标对步长。 Transforms the attachment's local to world coordinates. If the slot's is not empty, it is used to deform the vertices.

输出数组开始写入的位置。 The index to begin writing values.
相邻顶点坐标对之间的数组步长。 The number of entries between the value pairs written.

member.name: T:Spine.Bone
member.summary:
骨骼当前姿势，包含局部、世界和已应用变换；约束或外部代码修改世界矩阵后，已应用变换可能不同于原局部变换。 Stores a bone's current pose.
A bone has a local transform which is used to compute its world transform. A bone also has an applied transform, which is a local transform that can be applied to compute the world transform. The local transform and applied transform may differ if a constraint or application code modifies the world transform after it was computed from the local transform.

从世界矩阵反算已应用局部变换，适用于约束或外部代码直接修改世界矩阵后；负缩放与旋转可能对应同一矩阵，反算存在歧义。 Computes the individual applied transform values from the world transform. This can be useful to perform processing using the applied transform after the world transform has been modified directly (eg, by a constraint)..

See IK constraints in the Spine User Guide.

member.name: M:Spine.Skeleton.SetSkin(Spine.Skin)

summary.para: 设置当前皮肤并更新缓存；优先从新皮肤替换旧附件，无旧皮肤时用初始附件。可调用 SetSlotsToSetupPose 重置显示，再应用动画关键帧。
Sets the skin used to look up attachments before looking in the . If the skin is changed, is called.
Attachments from the new skin are attached if the corresponding attachment from the old skin was attached. If there was no old skin, each slot's setup mode attachment is attached from the new skin.

After changing the skin, the visible attachments can be reset to those attached in the setup pose by calling . Also, often is called before the next time the skeleton is rendered to allow any attachment keys in the current animation(s) to hide or show attachments from the new skin.

member.param: 要切换到的皮肤，可以为 null。 May be null.

member.summary: 计算当前姿势下区域和网格附件的轴对齐包围盒；输出左下角相对骨架原点的偏移及宽高，可复用传入的顶点暂存数组。Returns the axis aligned bounding box (AABB) of the region and mesh attachments for the current pose.
